title: rayx_reactive releases: release-plz git tags from v1.0.0 under the 1.x policy, one root changelog, consumption by tag

checks.descriptionMarkdown: Ruby stdlib YAML (`on` parses as `true`): REL-2 structure (including `release-pr` `needs: release`), CI-1 triggers (push to `main` kept)/jobs/no benchmarks, only these two workflow files.
argv:
require "yaml"
files = Dir.glob(".github/workflows/*.{yml,yaml}").sort
abort "workflow files: #{files}" unless files == [".github/workflows/ci.yml", ".github/workflows/release-plz.yml"]
text = File.read(".github/workflows/release-plz.yml")
w = YAML.safe_load(text)
on = w.key?("on") ? w["on"] : w[true]
abort "release-plz.yml triggers: #{on.inspect}" unless on.keys.sort == ["push", "workflow_dispatch"] && on["push"] == { "branches" => ["main"] }
jobs = w["jobs"]
abort "release-plz.yml jobs: #{jobs.keys}" unless jobs.keys.sort == ["release", "release-pr"]
abort "release-pr must have needs: release" unless [jobs["release-pr"]["needs"]].flatten == ["release"]
abort "release must not wait for another job" if jobs["release"].key?("needs")
token = "${{ secrets.RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN }}"
jobs.each do |name, job|
  abort "#{name}: repository guard" unless job["if"] == "github.repository == 'rayx-ui/RayX.Reactive'"
  steps = job["steps"]
  checkout = steps.find { |s| s["uses"].to_s.start_with?("actions/checkout@") }
  abort "#{name}: checkout needs fetch-depth 0 and RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN" unless checkout && checkout.dig("with", "fetch-depth") == 0 && checkout.dig("with", "token") == token
  action = steps.find { |s| s["uses"] == "release-plz/action@v0.5" }
  abort "#{name}: needs release-plz/action@v0.5 with command #{name} and GITHUB_TOKEN = RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN" unless action && action.dig("with", "command") == name && action.dig("env", "GITHUB_TOKEN") == token
  abort "#{name}: the release workflow runs no shell steps or tests" if steps.any? { |s| s.key?("run") }
end
secrets = text.scan(/secrets\.([A-Za-z0-9_]+)/).flatten.uniq
abort "release-plz.yml secrets: #{secrets}" unless secrets == ["RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN"]
ci_text = File.read(".github/workflows/ci.yml")
ci = YAML.safe_load(ci_text)
ci_on = ci.key?("on") ? ci["on"] : ci[true]
abort "ci.yml triggers: #{ci_on.inspect}" unless (ci_on.keys - ["workflow_dispatch"]).sort == ["pull_request", "push"] && ci_on["push"] == { "branches" => ["main"] }
abort "ci.yml jobs: #{ci["jobs"].keys}" unless ci["jobs"].keys.sort == ["docs", "macos", "msrv", "rust", "wasm-tests"]
abort "ci.yml runs benchmarks" if ci_text.match?(/cargo\s+(\+\S+\s+)?bench/)
puts "workflows ok"

checks.descriptionMarkdown: AgentX's workflow YAML checker (syntax, duplicate keys GitHub rejects); adjust the path to the local AgentX install if it moved.

Ruby: `cargo metadata --locked` succeeds and reports `rayx_reactive 1.0.0` and `rayx_reactive_doc_examples 0.0.0`; `CHANGELOG.md` starts with the `[changelog] header` text of `release-plz.toml`, has no `Unreleased` section or "unpublished (0.1)", has exactly one release section `## [1.0.0] - YYYY-MM-DD`, keeps the eleven *Migration:* notes and the topic subsections.
argv:
require "json"
require "open3"
out, status = Open3.capture2("cargo", "metadata", "--locked", "--format-version", "1")
abort "cargo metadata --locked failed: Cargo.lock is not in step with the manifests" unless status.success?
meta = JSON.parse(out)
members = meta["packages"].select { |p| meta["workspace_members"].include?(p["id"]) }
versions = members.map { |p| [p["name"], p["version"]] }.to_h
abort "workspace versions: #{versions}" unless versions == { "rayx_reactive" => "1.0.0", "rayx_reactive_doc_examples" => "0.0.0" }
config = File.read("release-plz.toml")
header = config[/^header = """\n?(.*?)"""/m, 1] or abort "release-plz.toml has no [changelog] header"
log = File.read("CHANGELOG.md")
abort "CHANGELOG.md does not start with the configured [changelog] header" unless log.start_with?(header)
abort "CHANGELOG.md still calls the crate unpublished (0.1) or keeps an Unreleased section" if log.match?(/unpublished \(0\.1\)|^## \[?Unreleased/i)
sections = log.scan(/^## \[([^\]]+)\] - (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})$/)
abort "release sections: #{sections}" unless sections.map(&:first) == ["1.0.0"]
abort "the 1.0.0 section lost migration notes" unless log.scan("*Migration:*").size >= 11
%w[Delivery Errors Collection Time Signals Commands].each { |t| abort "the 1.0.0 section lost ### #{t}" unless log.match?(/^### #{t}/) }
puts "version and changelog ok"

checks.descriptionMarkdown: Asserts the 1.x policy lines of `release-plz.toml`, then previews A-D of REL-3 with the pinned local release-plz (another version is refused, so a reused result stays honest) in rsync copies of the working tree under ignored `artifacts-temp/agentx/reactive-releases/dry-run/`; each copy drops its tags, disables its push URL and commits the working tree first. Logs stay there.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
release-plz --version | grep -qx 'release-plz 0.3.172' || { echo 'need release-plz 0.3.172 (the version release-plz/action@v0.5 installs)'; exit 2; }
fail() { echo "FAIL: $*"; exit 1; }
grep -qxF 'release_commits = "^(feat|fix|perf)"' release-plz.toml || fail 'release_commits must be "^(feat|fix|perf)" (1.x policy)'
grep -qE '^semver_check *= *false' release-plz.toml || fail 'semver_check must be false (1.x policy)'
root=$PWD
base=$root/artifacts-temp/agentx/reactive-releases/dry-run
rm -rf "$base"; mkdir -p "$base"
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$base/target
G() { git -c user.name=dry-run -c user.email=dry-run@invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false -c tag.gpgsign=false "$@"; }
copy() {
  cd "$root"
  rsync -a --exclude /target --exclude /artifacts-temp ./ "$base/$1/"
  cd "$base/$1"
  for t in $(git tag -l); do git tag -d "$t" >/dev/null; done
  git remote set-url --push origin no-push://disabled
  git add -A
  G commit -qm 'chore: working tree snapshot' --allow-empty
}
ver() { sed -n 's/^version = "\(.*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml | head -n 1; }
update() { release-plz update >"$base/$1.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 40 "$base/$1.log"; fail "release-plz update ($1)"; }; }
mark() { printf '\n// release dry run: %s\n' "$1" >> crates/src/lib.rs; }
newest() { awk '/^## \[1\.0\.0\]/{exit} {print}' CHANGELOG.md; }

# A: no v* tag yet (history still holds pre-1.0 `!` commits and BREAKING CHANGE footers) -> initial release: 1.0.0 stays, nothing changes
copy a; update a
[ "$(ver)" = 1.0.0 ] || fail "A: version $(ver)"
git diff --quiet || fail "A: release-plz changed files without a tag"

# B: fix after v1.0.0 -> 1.0.1, new section in the root CHANGELOG.md under the one header
copy b; G tag v1.0.0; mark b; G commit -qam 'fix(signal): dry-run patch'; update b
[ "$(ver)" = 1.0.1 ] || fail "B: version $(ver)"
grep -A1 '^name = "rayx_reactive"$' Cargo.lock | grep -q 'version = "1.0.1"' || fail "B: Cargo.lock not bumped"
grep -q '^version = "0.0.0"$' doc-examples/Cargo.toml || fail "B: doc-examples version changed"
[ ! -e crates/CHANGELOG.md ] || fail "B: release-plz wrote crates/CHANGELOG.md"
[ "$(grep -c '^# Changelog$' CHANGELOG.md)" = 1 ] || fail "B: changelog header duplicated"
[ "$(grep -c '^All notable changes' CHANGELOG.md)" = 1 ] || fail "B: changelog header text duplicated"
grep -m1 '^## \[' CHANGELOG.md | grep -qE '^## \[1\.0\.1\] - [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' || fail "B: first section is not 1.0.1"
grep -q '^## \[1\.0\.0\] - ' CHANGELOG.md || fail "B: lost the 1.0.0 section"
newest | grep -q '^### Fixes$' || fail "B: no Fixes group"
newest | grep -qF -- '*(signal)* dry-run patch' || fail "B: no entry for the fix"

# C: a feat that describes a break, with a Migration: footer -> 1.1.0 (minor, 1.x policy) and the rendered note
copy c; G tag v1.0.0; mark c
G commit -qam 'feat(collections): dry-run break' -m 'This dry-run change breaks the public API on purpose.' -m 'Migration: dry-run migration note'
update c
[ "$(ver)" = 1.1.0 ] || fail "C: version $(ver)"
newest | grep -q '^### Features$' || fail "C: no Features group"
newest | grep -qF -- '*(collections)* dry-run break' || fail "C: no entry for the feat"
newest | grep -qF '*Migration:* dry-run migration note' || fail "C: Migration footer not rendered"
if newest | grep -qF '[**breaking**]'; then fail "C: entry marked breaking"; fi

# D: only docs, chore(agentx) and refactor commits -> no release
copy d; G tag v1.0.0
printf '\n<!-- release dry run -->\n' >> README.md; G commit -qam 'docs(readme): dry-run docs change'
printf '\n' >> .agentx/memory/decisions/INDEX.md; G commit -qam 'chore(agentx): dry-run metadata'
mark d; G commit -qam 'refactor(signal): dry-run refactor'
update d
[ "$(ver)" = 1.0.0 ] || fail "D: version $(ver)"
git diff --quiet || fail "D: release-plz changed files without a release commit"
echo 'release dry run ok'

checks.descriptionMarkdown: Ruby: README and getting started show the tag form, have no untagged git, path or crates.io `0.1` form, getting started's diagnostics example carries the tag, and the README links `docs/releasing.md`.
argv:
tag = 'rayx_reactive = { git = "https://github.com/rayx-ui/RayX.Reactive", tag = "v1.0.0" }'
docs = { "README.md" => File.read("README.md"), "docs/02-getting-started.md" => File.read("docs/02-getting-started.md") }
docs.each do |name, text|
  abort "#{name}: missing #{tag}" unless text.include?(tag)
  abort "#{name}: still promises a crates.io 0.1 release" if text.match?(/Once (it|the crate) is published|"0\.1"/)
  abort "#{name}: a git dependency without a release tag" if text.match?(%r{git = "https://github\.com/rayx-ui/RayX\.Reactive"(?!, tag = "v)})
  abort "#{name}: a path dependency on a checkout" if text.include?('path = "../RayX.Reactive')
end
abort "getting started: the diagnostics example lacks the tag" unless docs["docs/02-getting-started.md"].include?('tag = "v1.0.0", features = ["diagnostics"]')
abort "README.md does not link docs/releasing.md" unless docs["README.md"].include?("docs/releasing.md")
puts "install docs ok"

checks.descriptionMarkdown: The existing test that exercises the touched documents: `doc-examples` compiles and runs every checked Rust block of README and `docs/*.md` (about 134 tests; `docs/releasing.md` must add none). This is the command CLAUDE.md names after documentation edits; it is not a whole-workspace run.

Ruby: `CLAUDE.md` equals `AGENTS.md` and has a `## Releases` section naming `docs/releasing.md`, `Migration:`, `1.x` and `--force-with-lease`; the skill no longer mentions `Unreleased` and names the `Migration:` footer; `docs/releasing.md` has no Rust block and names `RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN`, `force-with-lease`, `ruleset`, `semver_check`, `1.x`, `Migration:` and the by-hand `git tag`; the contributing chapter links it. DOC-2's content quality is a review item.
argv:
claude = File.read("CLAUDE.md")
abort "CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md differ" unless claude == File.read("AGENTS.md")
releases = claude[/^## Releases\n(.*?)(?=^## |^<!-- agentx:begin)/m, 1] or abort "CLAUDE.md has no Releases section"
["docs/releasing.md", "Migration:", "1.x", "force-with-lease"].each { |s| abort "Releases section lacks #{s}" unless releases.include?(s) }
skill = File.read(".claude/skills/rayx-reactive/SKILL.md")
abort "the rayx-reactive skill still sends changes to an Unreleased CHANGELOG section" if skill.include?("Unreleased")
abort "the rayx-reactive skill does not name the Migration: footer" unless skill.include?("Migration:")
rel = File.read("docs/releasing.md")
abort "docs/releasing.md has a rust block (doc-examples would compile it)" if rel.match?(/^```rust/)
%w[RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN force-with-lease ruleset semver_check 1.x Migration:].each { |s| abort "docs/releasing.md lacks #{s}" unless rel.include?(s) }
abort "docs/releasing.md lacks the by-hand git tag fallback" unless rel.match?(/git tag v(X\.Y\.Z|\d)/)
abort "docs/20-contributing.md does not link releasing.md" unless File.read("docs/20-contributing.md").include?("releasing.md")
puts "guidance ok"

Write `release-plz.toml` per REL-1: `git_release_enable = true`, `release_commits = "^(feat|fix|perf)"` and `semver_check = false` with comments citing the 1.x policy, `[[package]]` entries for `rayx_reactive` (`changelog_path = "./CHANGELOG.md"`) and `rayx_reactive_doc_examples` (`release = false`), the CLI's `[changelog]` with the header naming `rayx_reactive` and the `*Migration:*` line for `Migration` footers (`commit.footers`, token `Migration`). tasks.title: Preview the release behaviour with local release-plz runs
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Install release-plz at the version `release-plz/action@v0.5` currently installs (read the action's `action.yml` at v0.5 or the latest RayX.CLI Release-plz run log; 0.3.172 on 2026-10-14) into the user's cargo bin; if it moved, amend the pin in `check-release-dry-run` first. cargo-semver-checks is not needed. The sprint checks run `check-release-dry-run` (REL-3) against the final config: a failing preview is a configuration finding (for example a header mismatch, a wrong `changelog_path`, the version written into `crates/Cargo.toml`, or the `Migration:` footer template), fixed in `release-plz.toml`/`CHANGELOG.md`, never by weakening the preview.

tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Verify OWN-1 with `gh secret list --repo rayx-ui/RayX.Reactive` (names only), `gh api repos/rayx-ui/RayX.Reactive/rulesets` and each ruleset's detail ("Release tags" on `refs/tags/v*` with `update`, `deletion`, `non_fast_forward`, no bypass; the `main` branch ruleset with the `dXnSix` bypass). tasks.title: Push (pre-approved) and confirm the v1.0.0 release and CI
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: If the push day differs from the `## [1.0.0]` date, fix it (`docs(changelog): ...`) and re-run `check-version-changelog`. Then, pre-approved by the owner: `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease origin main`. Watch the Release-plz run and `ci.yml`'s push run (`gh run list/watch --repo rayx-ui/RayX.Reactive`) and confirm FIRST-1: the `release` log line, `git ls-remote origin refs/tags/v1.0.0` against the pushed head, `gh release view v1.0.0 --repo rayx-ui/RayX.Reactive --json tagName,isDraft,isPrerelease,author,body`, `gh pr list --repo rayx-ui/RayX.Reactive` (no release PR), and a green `ci.yml` run. On a checkout/push failure of Release-plz, report the PAT access gap to the owner and re-run only after the fix; never retry blindly. An unexpected release PR is left unmerged and reported (a `2.0.0` proposal means a stray `!`).
